title: feat(core)!: retire the bare-string `globalFilters[].options` lift (objectui#4356)
body:
Fixes #4356

Clause-②: yes — published runtime behaviour is removed (the bare-string lift, and the exported `resetDashboardFilterWarnings` if it retires with its memo), per the execution parameters in `5511028727`.

The claim's "if" resolved to **stays**: the memo survives (it now dedupes the dropped-member warning, see "The audible-skip question"), so `resetDashboardFilterWarnings` keeps its job and its export; the changeset names no removed export.

## What changed

Phase 2 of objectui#4356 — the runtime bare-string `globalFilters[].options` lift retires.

- `packages/core/src/utils/dashboard-filters.ts` — in `normalizeFilterOptions`, the non-object arm no longer pushes `{ value: String(o), label: String(o) }`. A member that is not an object (string, number, boolean) yields NO option: a shorthand-only filter resolves with no `options`, a mixed array keeps only its object members. The nullish / value-less skips are unchanged. The Phase 1 deprecation warning (`warnShorthandOptions`, whose text said "Still lifted here") is deleted; a dev-mode, once-per-filter `warnDroppedShorthandOptions` names the filter, the dropped members and the rewrite, and promises no lift. The `DashboardFilterDef.options` JSDoc, the `normalizeFilterOptions` docblock, the memo docblock and the `resetDashboardFilterWarnings` docblock stop describing a lift. No lift, alias, fallback or migration is added anywhere.
- `packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/dashboard-filters.test.ts` — every lift-pinning test is flipped to pin the new contract (red-first below): `normalizes options: spec {value,label} objects AND bare-string shorthand` becomes `normalizes spec {value,label} objects, and DROPS a bare-string member rather than lifting it`; the `[#4356]` describe is rewritten as `retired: dropped, not lifted` — a shorthand-only filter yields no `options`; a mixed array keeps only its object members; a number and a boolean are dropped too; warn ONCE across renders while dropping on every render; a different filter warns separately; canonical `{ value, label }` options and an `I18nLabel` map are untouched and silent; `resetDashboardFilterWarnings` re-arms the memo.
- `content/docs/guide/dashboard-filters.md` — the "Deprecated: … still lifted by the runtime" callout became false and now reads "Not accepted": refused at publish, no longer lifted, a bare-string member yields no option, rewrite `"X"` as `{ "value": "X", "label": "X" }`. No fenced block changed (the hunk is one blockquote of prose with inline code).
- `packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts` — the JSDoc of the exported `GlobalFilterSchema` said "The runtime is untouched: `@object-ui/core`'s `normalizeFilterOptions` still LIFTS a stored bare-string option on read". That sentence ships in `@object-ui/types`' emitted declarations and this PR makes it false, so it is corrected in place. ⚠️ This file is outside the claim's declared file surface; see "Deviation" below.
- `.changeset/retire-options-shorthand-lift-4356.md` — `@object-ui/core: minor`, opening with the ruled wording: "bare-string `globalFilters[].options` is no longer lifted; use `{ value, label }` objects, the spec's form". Never `major` (AGENTS.md §9 version policy: the break is stated in the body, the bump stays `minor`); `check-changeset-no-major` exit 0.

Untouched on purpose: `examples/schema-catalog/test/plugin-dashboard-global-filters-spec.test.ts` (the `GlobalFilterSchema` catalog guardrail from PR #4601 — the positive control; its docblock narrates history and states spec facts only, nothing in it says the runtime lifts, so it stays true); the two `packages/types` tests that pin the SPEC's refusal of `options: ['EMEA']` (`dashboard-header-global-filters-spec-7759.test.ts`, `report-chart-query-spec-parity.test.ts`) — rejection pins, not lift pins, still true; `@objectstack/spec`; `content/docs/releases/**`; `skills/**` (no file there becomes false — measured below).

## Rulings executed

- objectstack-ai/objectstack#7917, maintainer 2026-08-12, verbatim 「7917 ②」 — the spec stays strict; the runtime bare-string lift retires.
- Maintainer, 2026-09-02, verbatim 「objectstack#7917 不考虑现有数据」 (director release `5511028727` on objectui#4356) — Phase 2 on release cadence alone; no live-tenant survey, no migration entry.
- Maintainer direct dispatch to the `domain:spec @ objectui` seat, verbatim 「这个你也接管继续 https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/4356」.

## The audible-skip question — governing text found

The dispatch asked whether any governing text requires the post-removal skip to be audible. What was read, verbatim:

- objectstack `AGENTS.md`, "Degradation log levels — `warn` vs `error`": "**Functional degradation → `warn` / `info`.** A screen is missing, a trigger is not armed, a capability is not enabled … The system is *visibly* smaller than it should be, and the next person to use the missing thing finds out." and "**prefer failing to falling back**, and when you must fall back, say what was lost." — A `select` filter whose members were all bare strings now renders with an empty option list (`DashboardFilterBar`: `const authored = def.options?.length ? def.options : (dynamicOptions ?? [])`): visibly smaller, functional, `warn`-level — and "say what was lost" is the operative sentence.
- objectstack `docs/adr/0078-no-silently-inert-metadata.md`, §4 "Loud-not-silent at the runtime seam": "Where the runtime *skips* an inert instance … it emits a **dev-mode diagnostic** at registration rather than swallowing it silently. This is the only layer that is **authoring-tool-agnostic** — it catches an inert instance regardless of which surface … produced it". The ADR's completeness gate (§1) is about Zod-VALID instances and a bare string is Zod-invalid — the spec refuses it at the door — but §4 is exactly the case here: a STORED dashboard is the one document no author-time gate re-reads.
- objectui `AGENTS.md`: no clause on audibility; #0.1 (contract-first, no lenient fallback in the renderer) is honoured — a diagnostic is not a fallback, and nothing is lifted.
- The module's own convention, same file: `buildFilterCondition` — "anything else → skipped with a console warning, never silently downgraded"; `buildWidgetScopedFilter` skips an unknown default field "with a console warning instead of emitting a query".

Conclusion: yes, at `warn`, dev-mode, deduped — the smallest audible path consistent with the ruling. Implemented as `warnDroppedShorthandOptions`: same `isDev()` gate and same memo key as Phase 1 (so no per-render flood), new sentence (DROPPED, "no longer lifted", the rewrite), no lift. Consequence: the memo and therefore `resetDashboardFilterWarnings` stay. Both are in the report's `open_questions` for the seat to strike if it disagrees — removing the warning is a delete, not a redesign.

## Measurements against the dispatch's mechanism assumptions

1. Lift live on `origin/main` `733fd5ac6` — confirmed: the `else` arm pushed `{ value: String(o), label: String(o) }` and called `warnShorthandOptions` for EVERY non-nullish primitive. Pinned now in `drops EVERY non-object member — a number and a boolean, not only a string`.
2. `resetDashboardFilterWarnings` — `git grep` repo-wide: importers are `dashboard-filters.test.ts` only (plus a `packages/core/CHANGELOG.md` paragraph); it clears only `warnedShorthandOptions`. The inference "with the memo gone it has no job" is falsified by the answer to (4): the memo does not go. It stays, with a docblock saying why.
3. Fixture recount, repo-wide over every file containing `globalFilters` (tests included; positive control: the same matcher found the callout it was meant to find): lift-pinning bare-string members exist only in `dashboard-filters.test.ts` — six members across five tests (the `normalizes options …` test; and in the `[#4356]` describe: `still lifts a bare string, byte-identically, AND warns`, `warns ONCE per offending filter …`, `warns separately for a DIFFERENT filter …` with two, and `names ONLY the bare members of a MIXED array` with the bare `'lost'` — the one the dispatch's list did not have). The director's "three" and the dispatch's "five" were both stale. All six retire or flip. The two `packages/types` occurrences pin the spec's REFUSAL and stay.
4. Skip audibility — see the section above.
5. Teaching sites — `git grep -i "shorthand|still lifted|is lifted"` over `content/docs`, `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md`, `content/docs/plugins`, `examples/schema-catalog`, `apps`, `skills`, `packages/*/README.md` (CHANGELOGs and `content/docs/releases` excluded), filtered to option/filter context: the callout (control, found) and the catalog guardrail's history narration (judged: stays true). A second sweep for bare-string `options` arrays found three sites — `content/docs/guide/expressions.md`, `content/docs/guide/schema-playground.md`, `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md` — all on `select` FIELDS (form / object field schemas), not `globalFilters`: a different contract, out of this card, ⛔ not touched, and the governed `skills/**` file does not become false.
6. Release — `packages/core/package.json` is `17.6.0`; `.changeset/config.json` has `@object-ui/core` in the `fixed` group; a `minor` changeset makes the next release ≥ 17.7.0; release PR #5400 is open (not touched).

## Tests

Red-first — the new pins against the UNTOUCHED source (`git diff --stat -- packages/core/src/utils/dashboard-filters.ts` empty at that moment), `pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/dashboard-filters.test.ts`, exit 1:

```text

× DROPS a bare string: a shorthand-only filter resolves with no `options`, and says so
× keeps ONLY the object members of a MIXED array, and names only the dropped ones
× drops EVERY non-object member — a number and a boolean, not only a string
× warns ONCE per offending filter across repeated renders, and drops on every one of them
AssertionError: expected [ …(2) ] to be undefined
AssertionError: expected [ Array(2) ] to deeply equal [ { value: 'won', label: 'Won' } ]
AssertionError: expected [ { value: '42', label: '42' }, …(2) ] to deeply equal [ { value: 'gold', label: 'Gold' } ]
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  5 failed | 44 passed (49)
```

The three that stayed green on the old code are the ones the block labels as non-discriminating (different-filter memo, canonical silence, memo reset).

Green, same command after the source change, exit 0: `Test Files 1 passed (1)` · `Tests 49 passed (49)`.

Consumer sweep (`resolveDashboardFilterDefs` consumers re-derived by `git grep`: `core`, `types`, `plugin-dashboard`, `plugin-designer`, `app-shell`, `examples/schema-catalog` — the same census PR #4601 recorded), one `pnpm exec vitest run` from the repo root under the shared verify lock, JSON reporter, exit 0:

Totals: `Test Files 335 passed (335)` · `Tests 5073 passed | 6 skipped (5079)`. No consumer fixture asserted the old lift (assumption 3's sweep found none outside `core`).

## Serial constraint

PR #10914 (objectui#10803 batch 6) edits two citation comments in `dashboard-filters.ts` (the `GlobalFilterSchema.object` JSDoc citation and the `// Spread rather than assigned` comment) — disjoint from every hunk here. It is still open at hand-back; `origin/main` is unchanged since the branch point. If it lands first, this branch merges `main` keeping both sides.

## Deviation — one file outside the claimed surface

`packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts` is not in claim `5865368364`'s file surface. It was edited under the bounded in-place-fix exemption, all four conditions measured: ① same defect class as the in-scope docblocks (prose describing a lift that no longer exists — and this one is the JSDoc of the exported `GlobalFilterSchema`, so it ships in `@object-ui/types`' emitted declarations); ② mechanical, form pinned (state that the runtime followed the spec; the `{ preset }` alias paragraph re-anchored); ③ no other holder — none of the 13 open PRs touches the file (files API, each PR); ④ same gate family — `@object-ui/types` is already in core's dependency closure built and type-checked here, its lint ran, and the changeset-presence gate is satisfied by this PR's changeset. The seat is asked to amend the claim's file surface in the same round.

## Acceptance notes

- `warnDroppedShorthandOptions` is dev-only, exactly as the Phase 1 warning was. The module's other skip warnings (`buildFilterCondition`'s unknown-preset skip, `buildWidgetScopedFilter`'s unknown-field skip) are not dev-gated; making this one always-on is a one-line change and is left to the seat (report `open_questions`).
- Field-level `select` schemas teaching `options: ['…']` (the three sites in assumption 5) are a different contract and were not judged here — observation only, not filed.
- `packages/plugin-dashboard/CHANGELOG.md` and `packages/core/CHANGELOG.md` still narrate the lift as history; published record, not re-addressed (AGENTS.md #11).
- The pending `.changeset/7759-dashboard-header-global-filters-spec.md` says the shorthand "is refused with `invalid_type`" by the validator — still true, untouched.
